articles.description: Pakistan approves amendments to its 2023 Oil Refining Policy to accelerate refinery upgrades, boost Euro-V fuel output, and attract Gulf investment. articles.title: Australia announces potential new oil refinery for the country, first since the 1960s
articles.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has announced a joint plan with West Australia's government to fund a new study into large-scale oil refinery. The refinery is aimed at protecting the country's economy from further global energy shocks. If the refinery goes ahead, it would be the first new large-scale petrol refinery built in Australia since the 1960s. This comes as the cut in fuel excise is due to expire by the end of the week

articles.title: US Stock Market: Wall Street divided on Fed as rising crude prices boost rate hike expectations
articles.description: The US Federal Reserve's policy meeting has become harder to predict as surging oil prices and renewed geopolitical tensions raise the risk of persistent inflation. While most brokerages still expect rates to remain unchanged, some now see a growing possibility of surprise hikes, with markets significantly increasing the odds of a policy move.
